notes: Rates are blended per person-week and assume a five-day week of productive delivery time.
A rate card carries its own currency. ROM is calculated in that currency and no exchange-rate conversion is applied.
blended_rate_mode role_mix weights each role's rate by that role's share of the workstream effort. Mode explicit uses a single blended rate entered by the user.
Contingency is applied once, to the base effort cost, and is shown as a separate line in the ROM breakdown.
ROM excludes cloud consumption, third-party licences and software subscriptions, customer-side effort, travel and expenses, and any run or managed-service charges after handover.
If a role used by the estimate has no rate in the selected rate card, the affected ROM line is blocked rather than defaulted.
Figures are a rough order of magnitude for internal planning. They are not a quotation or a contractual commitment.
